AN340
Contemporary Issues in India
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An introduction to contemporary society and cultures of India, with a focus on issues related to such cultural phenomena as globalization, caste politics, ethnic nationalisms, grass-roots development, media and the Indian diaspora.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
